scopeNote: Bangkok specialty (third-wave) coffee shops and roasters that coffee writers and guides praise in 2025-2026, spread over Ari, Phaya Thai, Siam, Silom, Sathorn, Charoen Krung and Talat Noi, Chinatown (Song Wat), the Old Town, Asok and Phrom Phong, Thonglor, Ekkamai and Phra Khanong, with a few further out for coffee people; most roast their own beans.

items.priceText: Single-origin filter 150-200 THB, espresso drinks 130-160 THB (Thai Holiday Guide, Jul 2026).
dishes: Pour-over of a Thai single origin from a farm Roots buys from (for example Nawin and Tina's natural from Mae Suai, Chiang Rai)
Coffee Tree Cold Brew (the Barista's Choice on the Roots site, Oct 2026)
Flat white or piccolo with a Thai espresso blend
Cold brew with banana, or with cacao nibs
items.praise: The Way to Coffee (May 2026) calls Roots 'arguably one of Bangkok's finest coffee roasters'. Its Sensory Research Lead, Chatchalerm 'Boss' Lertanekwattana, won the 2025 World Cup Tasters Championship in Geneva (Barista Magazine, Aug 2025). Founder Varatt Vichit-Vadakan was Thailand's barista champion and competed at the 2014 World Barista Championship.
items.watchOut: A small bar on the Market Floor of theCOMMONS. Seats are shared with the food hall and fill up on weekends.
items.description: The Thonglor bar of Roots, the Bangkok roaster that has built its coffee around Thai farms since 2013. A good place to taste what northern Thailand grows.
items.openText: Daily 07:00-17:00 (Roots branch page and Google, Oct 2026).
tips: Other Roots bars: theCOMMONS Saladaeng (Silom, daily 07:30-17:30), Sathon (Bhiraj Tower), Ratchathewi (Asia Hotel, by the BTS), Ari, and EmQuartier (weekdays only).
Buy a bag of Thai single-origin beans to take home; the staff can tell you the farm and the process.
items.verification: Google Maps 27 Oct 2026 (4.5, open 07:00-17:00, pin). Roots branch page (hours of every branch, Oct 2026). The Way to Coffee (May 2026), Thai Holiday Guide (Jul 2026), Barista Magazine (Aug 2025; 2014 WBC profile), Wanderlog (count).

Yuzu matcha latte
items.praise: In almost every Bangkok coffee guide of 2025-2026. Sprudge (May 2025) lists the team's titles: World Siphonist Champion 2018, Thailand National Barista Champion 2019 and Thailand Brewers Cup Champion 2020 and 2024, and calls the menu the biggest specialty menu in Bangkok. Founder Warong 'Koong' Chalanuchpong is a much-awarded roaster.
items.watchOut: Busy and loud at weekends; some Google reviewers say ordering is slow at peak times. Rare slow-bar coffees can cost 400-600 THB a cup.
items.description: Nana's flagship in a garden house off Ari Soi 4: a big roaster-cafe with a long bean list, a slow bar and a competition team behind the counter.

Saint Dirty
Mocha Valencia

items.description: The Bangkok flagship of Pacamara, a Thai roaster, in a house on Thonglor Soi 25 with a coffee lab and an early opening.
items.openText: Daily from 06:30; Google showed 06:30-18:00 on Tuesday (Oct 2026).
tips: Roots at theCOMMONS is a 10-minute walk away on Thonglor 17.

items.name: Fika & Co. Cafe
items.gmapsQuery: Fika & Co. Cafe, Singha Complex, 1788 New Petchaburi Road, Bangkok
items.priceText: About 101-250 THB a person (Wongnai).
dishes: Espresso and milk coffee from a national champion
Caramel macchiato (a Wongnai reviewer's pick)
items.praise: Co-founded by Jane Kawinnart Veeraworawet, who won the Thailand National Barista Championship in 2023 and again at Thailand Coffee Fest 2025 (Thai PR, Jul 2025). She was the first Thai barista in a World Barista Championship semi-final (2023) and competed for Thailand at the 2026 World Barista Championship in Panama (Sprudge, Oct 2026).
items.watchOut: In an office tower; few writers have reviewed it, so the praise rests on the champion and on Google and Wongnai users.
items.description: The cafe of Thailand's current barista champion, on the ground floor of Singha Complex at the Asok-Phetchaburi junction.
items.bestTime: Weekday, with the office crowd gone after 09:30.
tips: Phetchaburi MRT is a short walk.
items.verification: Google Maps 27 Oct 2026 (4.8, open 08:30-17:30 today, pin). Sprudge WBC 2026 competitor list (22 Oct 2026), Thai PR article (30 Jul 2025), Wongnai listing.

items.name: Smokey Cat Coffee Roaster
items.gmapsQuery: Smokey Cat Coffee Roaster, Suanplu Corner Building, Soi Suan Plu, South Sathorn Road, Bangkok
items.priceText: About 100-150 THB a person (The Standard, 2023); house beans such as Costa Rica Santa Teresa (yellow honey) 480 THB for 100 g (BK Magazine, 2023).
dishes: Filter of a small-batch single origin
Flat white with the house roast
items.praise: A small-batch roaster with rotating roasts (BK Magazine roaster list); Sprudge (May 2025) names it among the Bangkok roasters to know.
items.watchOut: Few recent write-ups; the praise is mostly from Google users (4.7).
items.description: A small roaster-cafe in the Suan Plu area of Sathorn.
items.verification: Google Maps 27 Oct 2026 (4.7, open 08:00-17:00 today, pin). BK Magazine roaster list (2023), The Standard (2023), Sprudge (May 2025, name only), Wanderlog (count). No 2025-2026 review found.

items.name: Craftsman Roastery at Old Town
items.gmapsQuery: Craftsman Roastery at Old Town, 23 Bamrung Mueang Road, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok
items.priceText: About 120 THB a cup (Wongnai review, 2025).
dishes: Espresso or latte with the Wrench Wood house blend
Filter of the Huai Khun Phar single origin (northern Thailand)
Americano
A baked pie
items.praise: In Time Out's best new cafes of 2025 (Aug 2025): a century-old Sino-Portuguese shophouse where coffee is 'clearly the star', with beans from Craftsman's own roastery. Wongnai reviewers in 2025 call the coffee quality quite good; The Way to Coffee (May 2026) lists it.
items.watchOut: Queues and slow service at busy times (Wongnai, 2025).
items.description: The Old Town shop of Craftsman, a Thai roaster, in a restored shophouse on Bamrung Mueang Road near the Giant Swing.
items.openText: Daily 07:30-17:00 (Wongnai; Google showed the same on Tuesday 27 Oct 2026).
items.bestTime: Early, before the Old Town sights.
tips: ONIBUS COFFEE is about 10 minutes away on foot, past the Giant Swing.
items.verification: Google Maps 27 Oct 2026 (4.8, open 07:30-17:00 today, pin). Time Out best new cafes 2025 (Aug 2025), Wongnai (2025 reviews), The Way to Coffee (May 2026), Visit Thailand Today (count).

items.name: Single Lane Specialty Coffee
items.gmapsQuery: SINGLE LANE Specialty Coffee, 26/9 Sukhumvit 69 Alley, Phra Khanong Nuea, Bangkok
items.priceText: No recent price list found online.
dishes: Pour-over from a guest roaster (Sprudge had a washed coffee from Gringo Nordic)
Flat white with the house blend roasted by Pobnar
Basque burnt cheesecake
Sourdough grilled tuna sandwich
items.praise: Sprudge (May 2025): an Australian-style cafe with a big filter menu and a top shelf of coffees from roasters such as Coffee Collective, Market Lane and Stitch. The Way to Coffee (May 2026) lists it; 4.8 from 547 Google reviews.
items.watchOut: It does not roast; it brews other roasters' beans.
items.description: A small multi-roaster cafe off Sukhumvit 69, good for tasting imported filter coffees next to Thai ones.
items.bestTime: Morning, together with Hands and Heart nearby.
tips: Hands and Heart Coffee Roasters is a 5-minute walk away on Sukhumvit 67 (closed Tue-Wed).
items.verification: Google Maps 27 Oct 2026 (4.7, open 07:30-16:30 today, pin). Sprudge (May 2025), The Way to Coffee (May 2026), Wanderlog (count, week hours).
